messages.content: write a mail to student affair officer Abhay pawar sir for asking when will hostel payment and who will be the roomates list come

Here’s a concise and polite email you can send to the Student Affairs Officer:

---

**Subject:** Inquiry Regarding Hostel Payment and Roommate List

Dear Abhay Pawar Sir,

I hope this message finds you well.

I am writing to kindly ask when the hostel payment process will begin and when we can expect the list of allotted roommates to be released. This information will help in planning accordingly for the upcoming session.

Looking forward to your response.

Warm regards,  
[Your Full Name]  
[Your Enrollment Number / Roll Number]  
[Your Program & Year]  

---

Let me know if you want to make it more formal or include any additional details.
